name: RF EDA AI Schematic Assistant
description: Create and revise schematics with an AI design service
description_full: A compact RF EDA design assistant for KiCad: generate designs from Word or text, discuss and refine proposals, inspect indicator tables and reports, and apply designs to the schematic with one update action. Includes version history, task recovery and AI service configuration. Uses the matching KiCad schematic IPC build.
